title: Service Layer Tests (Prompt/Cache/Command Parser)
description: Create unit tests for 3 service modules: (1) prompt-manager-service.test.ts covering template loading and caching, variable substitution logic, and default prompt fallback; (2) commit-cache-service.test.ts covering cache key generation (already has partial tests, extend with cache invalidation and size limit scenarios); (3) command-parser.test.ts covering command string parsing, argument extraction and validation, and edge cases (empty string, special characters).

criteria: 2 new test files created: [prompt-manager-service.test.ts, command-parser.test.ts] — verify by ls src/services/prompt/__tests__/*.test.ts src/commands/generate-commit/utils/__tests__/*.test.ts | wc -l >= 2
1 existing test file extended: [commit-cache-service.test.ts] — verify new test cases added for invalidation and size limit
prompt-manager covers 3 scenarios: [template loading, variable substitution, default fallback] — verify by grep 'template\|variable\|fallback' in test
command-parser covers edge cases: [empty string, special characters, argument extraction] — verify by grep 'empty\|special\|argument' in test
All tests pass — verify by npx vitest run src/services/prompt src/services/cache src/commands/generate-commit/utils/__tests__ (exit code 0)
convergence.verification: npx vitest run src/services/prompt src/services/cache && npx vitest run src/commands/generate-commit/utils/__tests__/command-parser.test.ts

rationale.why: Prompt manager is on the commit generation critical path. Command parser has pure logic with high test ROI. Cache service needs invalidation coverage for regression protection.
rationale.approach: Create new test files for untested modules, extend existing cache test with invalidation scenarios. Can parallelize with IMPL-005 since both depend on IMPL-004.
